name: Charge 18
definition: Amount of money associated with a service.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of service for which a charge is asked or paid.

ExtendedType.name: Extended Type
ExtendedType.definition: Type of service for which a charge is asked or paid.

ChargeBasis.name: Charge Basis
ChargeBasis.definition: Method used to calculate a charge.

ExtendedChargeBasis.name: Extended Charge Basis
ExtendedChargeBasis.definition: Method used to calculate a charge.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money asked or paid for the charge.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Rate used to calculate the amount of the charge or fee.

RecipientIdentification.name: Recipient Identification
RecipientIdentification.definition: Party entitled to the amount of money resulting from a charge.

TypeOrExtendedTypeRule.definition: Either Type or ExtendedType must be present, but not both.

ChargeBasisOrExtendedChargeBasisRule.definition: Either ChargeBasis or ExtendedChargeBasis may be present, but not both.
